例句

  1. Thanks to the map you drew me the other day, I managed to get here without getting lost.
    多虧你前幾天幫我畫的地圖，我沒有迷路就順利到了這裡。
  2. Thanks to your help, I finished the work on time.
    多虧你的幫忙，我準時做完了工作。
  3. We won the game thanks to Tom.
    多虧了 Tom，我們贏了比賽。
  4. Thanks to the rain, the air is clean today.
    多虧下了雨，今天的空氣很乾淨。
  5. Thanks to my teacher's advice, I passed the exam.
    多虧我老師的建議，我通過了考試。
  6. Thanks to the new train line, we can get to the airport in thirty minutes.
    多虧新的鐵路線，我們三十分鐘就可以到機場。
  7. This is the book I bought yesterday.
    這是我昨天買的書。
  8. The girl you met at the party is my sister.
    你在派對上遇到的那個女生是我妹妹。
  9. The cake my mother made was delicious.
    我媽媽做的蛋糕很好吃。
  10. I lost the pen you gave me.
    我把你給我的筆弄丟了。
  11. Is this the bag you were looking for?
    這是你在找的包包嗎？
  12. The hotel we stayed at in Kyoto was very quiet.
    我們在京都住的飯店很安靜。
  13. I managed to catch the last train.
    我總算趕上了末班火車。
  14. She managed to finish her homework before dinner.
    她總算在晚餐前寫完功課。
  15. Did you manage to find a seat on the bus?
    你在公車上有找到位子嗎？
  16. The box was heavy, but we managed to carry it upstairs.
    箱子很重，但我們還是把它搬上樓了。
  17. I'm sure you will manage to pass the test.
    你一定能通過考試的。
  18. He went to bed without brushing his teeth.
    他沒刷牙就去睡覺了。
  19. Don't cross the street without looking both ways.
    不要沒看左右兩邊就過馬路。
  20. She went to school without eating breakfast.
    她沒有吃早餐就去上學了。
  21. I can't study without listening to music.
    我不聽音樂就沒辦法讀書。
  22. Tom borrowed my bike without asking me.
    Tom 沒有問我就借走了我的腳踏車。
  23. We walked around Taipei all day without getting tired.
    我們在台北逛了一整天也不覺得累。
  24. Thanks to the map you gave me, I found the museum easily.
    多虧你給我的地圖，我很容易就找到了博物館。
  25. I managed to get to the station without getting wet.
    我總算沒淋濕就到了車站。
  26. Thanks to the signs, we managed to find the hotel without asking anyone.
    多虧那些指標，我們沒有問任何人就找到了飯店。
  27. The dictionary you lent me helped me a lot.
    你借我的字典幫了我很多。
  28. He managed to answer all the questions without making a mistake.
    他總算把所有的題目都答完，而且一題都沒錯。
  29. Thanks to my brother, I got home without getting lost.
    多虧我哥哥，我沒有迷路就回到家了。
  30. The song you sang last night is still in my head.
    我腦子裡還一直是你昨晚唱的歌。
